`stock_report.py` now flags an item as `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than 6 days of average sales, and `LEAD_TIME_DAYS = 6` sits at the top of the file for you to change.

I ran it against your current `inventory.csv`:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend (9 on hand, about 14 needed for 6 days) and oat milk (30 on hand, 45 needed) are the two new flags. `OUT` still shows for an empty shelf, so you can tell "order now" from "already gone".

An item with exactly 6 days of stock left is still `ok`, since on average it runs out the day the delivery lands. There's no safety margin for a busier-than-average week; if you want one, raising `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` to 7 or 8 gives you a day or two of buffer.
